manpowerAccess.readOnlyBanner: View only — you can read manpower records here but cannot add, edit, delete or import them.
manpowerAccess.pageInfo: Data entry workers and operators fill the Daily Activity Sheet; team leaders can sign in on the main login page (choose Team leader, Employee ID and PIN). Every typed day waits for the operation manager to approve it. After a day is approved, request an edit or delete here — the operation manager reviews change requests.
manpowerAccess.rosterReadOnly: View only — only data entry workers and the operation manager can change the workers list.

cropHistoryAccess.plantingViewOnly: View only — workers and agronomists record planting and transplanting.
cropHistoryAccess.sowingViewOnly: View only — workers and agronomists record nursery sowing.
cropHistoryAccess.germinationViewOnly: View only — workers and agronomists record germination counts.
cropHistoryAccess.cropListViewOnly: View only — only the operation manager adds or changes crops and varieties here.

ipmCatalogAccess.pestViewOnly: View only. Workers and the pest agronomist edit the pest catalog and sampling units.
ipmCatalogAccess.productViewOnly: View only. Workers and the pest agronomist edit the product catalog, site product lists and crop PHI.

fieldStaffAccess.noPermission: Only the pest agronomist, crop agronomist, operation manager and data entry worker can manage field staff.
fieldStaffAccess.siteScopeNote: You can only see, add, link and reset PINs for field staff at the sites you are assigned to.

zoneAccess.title: Zones & Sites Management
zoneAccess.confirmDeleteZone: Are you sure you want to delete this zone and all its sites?
zoneAccess.confirmDeleteSite: Are you sure you want to delete this site?
zoneAccess.zoneCodeMax: Code must be 10 characters or less
zoneAccess.fmScopeNote: You can rename the zones assigned to you and add, rename or delete sites inside them. Other zones and sites are view only.
zoneAccess.fmNoZones: No zones are assigned to you yet. Ask the CEO to assign you a zone.
zoneAccess.viewOnlyNote: You can view your zones and sites. Only the CEO and farm managers can change them.
zoneAccess.zonesHelp: A farm manager can reach every site inside an assigned zone. They can rename the zone and add, rename or delete its sites.

farmAreaAccess.viewOnly: View only — farm areas are managed by the operation manager and the data entry worker.

fieldsAccess.fieldsViewOnly: View only. The operation manager and data entry worker add, rename, edit and delete fields.
fieldsAccess.valvesViewOnly: View only. The operation manager and data entry worker change valves.
fieldsAccess.polygonViewOnly: View only. The operation manager and data entry worker save field boundaries.

adminAccess.recipesViewOnly: View only. The data entry worker, agronomist and operation manager add, edit and delete recipes.
adminAccess.inventoryViewOnly: View only. The operation manager and data entry worker add items and record stock movements.
adminAccess.recoveryNoPermission: Only the data entry worker, agronomist and operation manager can restore deleted sheets.
adminAccess.thresholdsViewOnly: View only. The CEO and operation manager set agronomic thresholds.
adminAccess.gisViewOnly: View only. The CEO and operation manager add, sync, link and delete GIS layers.
adminAccess.systemKeysCeoOnly: Only the CEO can view or change the AI and OpenWeather keys.
adminAccess.trainingAuthorOnly: View only. The intern teacher creates and edits lessons, quizzes and questions.

dataEntryAccess.openingViewOnly: View only — the operation manager, agronomists and data entry workers add or change opening rows.
dataEntryAccess.manpowerCorrectionsSkipped: skipped {{count}} hours corrections on approved or other people's records (use a change request)
dataEntryAccess.manpowerCorrectionsSentForApproval: {{count}} changed approved records were sent to the operation manager for approval

manpowerCost.title: Manpower Cost
manpowerCost.subtitle: Cost = approved hours × rate per hour
manpowerCost.approvedOnlyNote: Only approved hours count. Pending and rejected days are left out.
manpowerCost.noData: No approved hours in this period.
manpowerCost.nothingToExport: No approved hours to export for this period.
manpowerCost.missingRateWarning: {{hours}} approved hours have no rate set and are left out of the total.

dashboard.offGroupNone: Every worker is on the group rate.

rates.pickSite: Choose a site to see and set its rates.
rates.readOnly: Only Data Entry Workers and Operation Managers can change rates.
rates.groupHelp: Applies to every worker in the group who has no personal rate.
rates.personalHelp: A personal rate replaces the group rate for that worker.
rates.noPersonal: No worker has a personal rate.
rates.backdateWarning: This start date is in the past. The cost of days already passed will change.
rates.deleteConfirm: Delete this rate? Days it covered will use the rate before it.
